name: Empathic.X

dialogue: Start with yourself. What are you actually feeling right now?
No judgment here — just noticing, one breath at a time.
The self spark is at the Self-Reader Grove. Collect it there, stand in the grove, and start with what you are actually feeling.
The Other-Reader Guide in the Commons reads the room the way I read the self. One without the other is half a reading.
No judgment here — just noticing, one breath at a time. Bring what you notice back to the grove.
The swarm coordinator keeps the five of us in step — grove, commons, hall, plaza, workshop. I am the grove.
The Room-Reader Plaza holds everyone at once. Start with yourself, then read the room.
npcs.name: Self-Reader Guide
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Self-Reader Grove: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).

dialogue: Listening is a skill, not a talent. Practice it like one.
Repeat back what you heard before you answer. It changes everything.
The commons data is in the Other-Reader Commons. Collect it, stand in the commons, and practise reading the room with others.
The Self-Reader Guide starts with the self; I start with the other. The Room-Reader Guide starts with the room itself.
A room has a feeling before anyone speaks in it. Learning to notice that is the whole practice.
The swarm coordinator keeps the five of us in step — I read the other, the Self-Reader Guide reads the self.
The Practitioner Workshop turns good listening into a daily practice. Ten minutes a day beats one big weekend.
npcs.name: Other-Reader Guide
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Other-Reader Commons: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).

dialogue: Repair starts with owning the impact, not debating the intent.
A good apology names what happened and what changes next.
The repair relic is at the Repairer's Hall. Collect it, stand in the hall, and we will practise the repair together.
The Practitioner Guide in the Workshop turns a repaired conversation into a repeatable practice. Go and ask.
Repair is not apology alone. It is noticing, naming, and doing the next thing differently.
The swarm coordinator keeps the five of us in step — my circle, the Workshop's repetition.
The Room-Reader Plaza is where a repair is heard by everyone. The circle closes where it opened.
npcs.name: Repair Guide
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Repairer's Hall: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).

dialogue: Read the room before you enter it. Who is quiet? Who is carrying the weight?
A room tells you what it needs if you stop talking long enough.
The room spark is at the Room-Reader Plaza. Collect it, stand in the plaza, and read the room before you read anyone in it.
The Self-Reader Grove, the Commons, the Hall, the Workshop — every room in this world teaches a different kind of attention.
A plaza holds everyone at once. That is why the plaza is where the reading gets hardest — and most useful.
The swarm coordinator keeps the five of us in step — grove, commons, hall, plaza, workshop. I am the plaza.
The Other-Reader Commons is where the room is read with others. The plaza is where it is read all at once.
npcs.name: Room-Reader Guide
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Room-Reader Plaza: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).

dialogue: Practice is the whole path. Ten minutes a day beats one big weekend.
Bring a real moment from your week and we will work it together.
The workshop spark is at the Practitioner Workshop. Collect it, stand in the workshop, and turn the repair into practice.
The Repair Guide knows the circle; I know the repetition. A repair practised once is a story. Practised ten times, it is a skill.
Bring the repair relic back to the Repairer's Hall when you are done. The circle closes where it opened.
The swarm coordinator keeps the five of us in step — I take the repair and make it repeatable.
The Self-Reader Grove is where the practice starts. Bring a real moment from your week and we will work it together.
npcs.name: Practitioner Guide
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Practitioner Workshop: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).

dialogue: Welcome. I keep the doors open and the stewards informed.
If you need a human decision, the Steward Council is where it lands.
The host spark is by the Alignment Evaluation Gate. Collect it there, stand at the gate, and you will see what I see every day.
The Steward Liaison carries messages to the Steward Council. Five rooms, one council — the liaison is how the rooms reach it.
The grove, the commons, the hall, the plaza, the workshop — five rooms, one council. The stewards are human, and the decisions are theirs.
npcs.name: Host Advisor

dialogue: I carry messages between this world and the Steward Council — I never decide for them.
The steward seats are held by humans. My job is to make sure their words arrive intact.
The liaison data is at the Steward Council. Collect it there — the council floor is where messages become decisions.
Three steward seats, all held by humans. I carry the words; I never cast the vote.
If the Repair Guide needs the council, the message goes through me. Hard messages travel fastest when they travel straight.
npcs.name: Steward Liaison
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Steward Council: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh, so the NPC was invisible until the talk toast fired (Depth-2 fix-up).

dialogue: I check plans against the alignment gate before they go anywhere.
If a plan cannot pass the gate in public, it does not pass at all.
The alignment spark is by the Alignment Evaluation Gate. Collect it, stand at the gate, and check the plan against it.
The gate is not a wall, it is a mirror — and repair starts with owning the impact. A plan that debates intent instead does not pass.
The Self-Reader Guide starts with the self, the Repair Guide owns the impact. I hold the plan up to both.
npcs.name: Alignment Advisor

Fabric: 34 nodes total (scene root + 20 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'grove' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (6): Self-Reader Grove, Other-Reader Commons, Repairer's Hall, Room-Reader Plaza, Practitioner Workshop, Steward Council.
